meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through creating the first NanoClaw agent for a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, wire the DM messaging group to a new agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导创建首个智能体并配置消息通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速搭建并测试第一个智能体机器人。
copy.tagline_en: Guide through creating the first agent and configuring messaging channels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly set up and test your first agent bot.

howto.what: Claude 会引导你创建第一个 NanoClaw 智能体，用于某个聊天频道（如 Discord、Telegram）。它会帮你确认频道身份、连接 DM 消息群组到新智能体，并触发一条欢迎私信。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 为已配置好凭据的频道创建第一个智能体时触发。通常在你运行过 /setup 并添加了频道之后。

say.text: 创建第一个智能体，用于 Discord 频道的欢迎私信。
say.note: Claude 将引导你完成设置并发送欢迎消息。

say.text: 帮我初始化 Telegram 频道的第一个智能体。
say.note: 需要你提供用户 ID 和名称。

howto.what_en: Claude will guide you through creating the first NanoClaw agent for a channel such as Discord or Telegram. It resolves your channel identity, wires a DM group to the new agent, and triggers a welcome DM.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to initialize the first agent for a channel with credentials already configured, typically after running /setup and adding a channel.

say_en.text: Create the first agent for Discord's welcome DM.
say_en.note: Claude will walk you through setup and send a welcome message.

say_en.text: Initialize the first agent for Telegram.
say_en.note: You'll need to provide your user ID and display name.
